Templates as data

Before the cases, two public template families were read as data, the same method on a template rather than a protocol: EU-PEARL (sections with keys, text categories from the template's own markers, field labels, a TOC check, and the MPT ↔ ISA alignment) and four TPP templates (column models compared, with concept matching left to a review file).

EU-PEARL templates as data

MPT 133, ISA 100, SAP 42, DMC 46 sections

MPT and ISA side by side: 90 in both, 43 MPT only, 10 ISA only; 37 field labels

REMAP-CAP: the DSA template no document states

581 headings of the nine DSAs under 191 titles: 36 in all nine, 63 in two or more

TPP templates compared

172 elements from FDA 2007, WOAH 2026, PaVe-GT and four NIH SEED examples

Four column models; 99 labels, 4 shared by two or more families
